title: Scan String and Calculate Length

content.problemStatement: Scan a string and calculate its length in the same scanf statement. The string can consist of spaces also.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input 'Hello World' produces expected output '' following problem rules.
Input 'Hello SEED candidate' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Scan a full string and output the string followed by its character length.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Read the entire line including spaces and print the string and its length separated by space.

hints: The string can contain space characters.
Read the entire line using fgets, getline, or nextLine.
Output the string and its length separated by a space.
learningObjectives: Format combined text and metric output.
